what: Second visual inspection of the 48-window label-audit sample (review sheets page00-05), one decision per camera view
by: Claude Opus 5.5, view by view, after the experiments; an independent check of every view by a second instance changed ten decisions (all towards more errors), recorded in the notes. The first inspection, by the executing agent before any training result, counted 10 wrong boxes of 103 without per-view records

categories.correct: box on the described target or its named part
categories.coarse: box on the target object but not on the named part (whole toaster, stove top, drawer front)
categories.wrong:robot: box on a robot link or the gripper
categories.wrong:instance: box on the wrong instance among duplicates
categories.wrong:carried_object: box on the carried object instead of the destination
categories.nv: labelled not visible (not audited for misses)
categories.wrong:other_object: box on another object (not the target, a duplicate of it, the robot or a chair)
